name: Breadcrumbs
description: Route-hierarchy navigation that links to one or more ancestors and identifies the current page as plain text. Breadcrumbs owns ordered hierarchy presentation while Link owns ancestor interaction and router/product code owns destinations.

props.name: ancestors
props.description: Required ordered ancestor hierarchy. At least one ancestor is required; no maximum or automatic overflow policy is established by this release.

props.name: currentLabel
props.description: Required non-empty label for the current route, rendered as plain text rather than another destination link.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the breadcrumb navigation landmark. Localize this when the surrounding product language is not English.

representations.mapsTo: inherited Light/Dark semantic token context; no theme prop

anatomy.name: navigation
anatomy.description: Named content-sized breadcrumb navigation landmark containing the ordered route hierarchy.

anatomy.name: ancestors
anatomy.description: One or more ancestor destinations in route order, each rendered through private _Breadcrumb Link Item anatomy.

anatomy.name: current-label
anatomy.description: Plain-text current location following the ancestor hierarchy and identified with aria-current=page.

semantics.element: named native nav landmark containing an ordered breadcrumb route hierarchy
semantics.accessibleName: ariaLabel names the breadcrumb navigation landmark and defaults to Breadcrumbs; ancestor Link labels name their destinations and currentLabel names the current route.
semantics.keyboardActivation: Ancestor destinations retain native Link keyboard activation. The current page and decorative separators are not interactive.
semantics.focus: Focus belongs only to ancestor Link descendants; Breadcrumbs itself, separators, and the current plain-text location do not become focusable.
requirements: Breadcrumbs requires at least one ancestor object with a non-empty label and non-empty href; this release establishes no maximum ancestor count or automatic collapse behavior.
currentLabel is required and non-empty. The current route is rendered as plain text rather than another link and exposes aria-current=page.
Each ancestor is a genuine native destination through the governed Link component; Breadcrumbs does not own router side effects or unsaved-change interception.
Each slash separator is decorative, excluded from the accessibility tree, and never part of the interactive ancestor target.
DOM and reading order remain ancestors first and current location last. Writing direction is inherited so RTL presentation follows the surrounding document without an RTL prop.

The Breadcrumbs root preserves the reviewed Figma HUG/HUG behavior by sizing to its route content while capping its inline size at the containing region; it does not deliberately stretch to full width.

The reviewed source uses an 8px inline gap between breadcrumb units, bound to spacing.semantic.gap.sm. Label/small typography is inherited from semantic tokens; current text uses fg/secondary and separators use fg/tertiary.
No overflow, collapse, ellipsis, back-navigation, workflow-progress, disabled/current-link, visited, or custom-separator behavior is established by the reviewed Figma source.

ancestors.description: Required ordered hierarchy containing one or more private _Breadcrumb Link Item compositions.

current.description: Required plain-text current route label; it is not another Link.

events.name: navigate
events.trigger: native activation of an ancestor Link
